name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: July Week 7 - Buzzer and Servo
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.example: The buzzer played a sound when the distance was too short.

words.definition: A sound with a certain pitch.
words.example: The tone became higher during the warning test.

words.definition: How fast something repeats, often for sound.
words.example: The frequency changed the pitch of the buzzer.
The duration controlled how long the sound played.

words.definition: A motor that moves to an angle.
words.example: The servo turned the pointer toward the warning label.
The angle set the servo position to 90 degrees.

words.definition: A wire that carries a control signal.
words.example: The signal wire connected the servo to the control pin.

words.definition: A smooth movement from one side to another.
words.example: The sweep moved the servo smoothly from left to right.
